title: Black bear over bait, Abitibi
description: Spring bear hunt from heated blinds over well-run bait sites. Lodging and meals included.

title: Moose and walleye, Haute-Mauricie
description: Fall moose hunt by canoe, and walleye fishing on the reservoir in summer. Experienced callers.

title: Atlantic salmon on the Gaspé rivers
description: Fly fishing for Atlantic salmon with a certified guide. Beginners welcome, gear provided.

title: White-tailed deer on Anticosti Island
description: Five days of deer hunting on the island, two deer per hunter, transport from Mont-Joli and lodge included.

title: Spring wild turkey, Outaouais
description: Morning turkey hunts on private farmland with decoys and blinds. Calling lessons for first-timers.

title: Snow goose and duck, Lac Saint-Pierre
description: Layout blinds and decoy spreads on the St. Lawrence flood plains, spring and fall. Retriever on site.

title: Ice fishing village, Lac Saint-Jean
description: Heated cabins on the ice, ouananiche and walleye. Day trips or overnight stays, family friendly.

title: Brook trout and lake trout fly-in, Nunavik
description: Fly-in camp on a remote lake: trophy brook trout and lake trout, boats and guides included.

title: Muskie on the Ottawa River
description: Trophy muskellunge from a fully equipped boat, fall season. Catch and release only.

title: Smallmouth bass, Kawartha Lakes
description: Half and full days of bass fishing on the Kawartha chain, spinning and fly. Kids welcome.

title: Black bear and grouse, Algoma
description: Fall bear over bait combined with ruffed grouse along the logging roads. Cabins on the lake.

title: Lake of the Woods walleye and pike
description: American plan fishing lodge: boats, guide, shore lunch. Walleye, pike and muskie on 14,000 islands.

title: Moose and deer, New Brunswick highlands
description: Guided moose hunt for draw winners and fall deer hunts from stands. Lodge with meals.

title: Miramichi salmon camp
description: Private pools on the Miramichi, wading and canoe. Atlantic salmon and sea-run brook trout.

title: Newfoundland moose and black bear
description: Remote boat-access camp: moose with a near-perfect success rate, bear as an add-on.

title: Coyote calling, Nova Scotia
description: Night and day predator calling on farmland, electronic callers and thermal optics.

title: Prairie ducks and geese, Saskatchewan
description: Field hunts over grain for Canada geese, specks and mallards. Fully guided, birds processed.

title: Trophy whitetail, Saskatchewan bush
description: Rut hunts from heated stands in the aspen parklands. Six days, one buck.

title: Trophy pike fly-in, northern Manitoba
description: Outpost camp with boats and motors. Pike over 40 inches and lake trout, all catch and release.

title: Spring black bear, Peace Country
description: Bait hunts with colour-phase bears common. Two bears per tag, wall tents or cabin.

title: Mountain caribou and moose, Yukon
description: Horseback hunt in the Mackenzie Mountains, ten days, one-on-one guiding.

title: Interior BC lakes, trout and grouse
description: Fly fishing for trout on the plateau lakes in summer, grouse hunting in the fall. Cabins included.

title: Great Slave Lake trophy lake trout
description: Week-long lodge trips for giant lake trout and pike, float plane from Yellowknife.

title: Pourvoirie in the Laurentians
description: All-inclusive pourvoirie: deer and bear in the fall, brook trout in stocked lakes all summer.
